title: Cardinality of the odd-multiplicity image
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $\pi:[n]\to[m]$, and let $S\subseteq[n]$. The set of indices $j\in[m]$ for which the fiber $\{i\in S:\pi(i)=j\}$ has odd cardinality has cardinality at most $|S|$.
replaced: For all $n,m\in\mathbb N$, maps $\pi:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$ and subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the set $O_{\pi}(S)=\{j\in\{1,\ldots,m\}:|\{i\in S:\pi(i)=j\}|\text{ is odd}\}$ satisfies $|O_{\pi}(S)|\leq|S|$.
